label: Each covered acquisition has source input or an earlier covered productive contributor
paraphrase: Open within a supplied exercise record. For each named source and each event in its covered family, either a source-borne event contributes by an actual exercised step to this event, or some covered event at a strictly lower natural-number stage does. One productive predecessor per covered event suffices. Warrant for the assigned coverage, stages, contributors and any temporal interpretation requires independent evidence.
